title: capture: Move sync pipe reading to header
description:
So that the extcaps can use this later, make some of the sync pipe
reading functions extern and in the header. Create a separate source
file for reading the sync pipe (dumpcap includes the file for writing
the sync pipe, but at least for now doesn't need to read it, since
the only message it receives is QUIT on Window, and no matter what
dumpcap receives on the signal pipe it tries to quit.)
